prompt: compare the sales from last year q4 with this year q1
title: Q4 vs Q1 Sales Comparison
summary: Compare sales performance from last year’s Q4 with this year’s Q1. Highlight changes in revenue, growth or decline, and any notable trends.
executed_sql_queries: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS min_order_date, MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date FROM retail.orders;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month_start, SUM(oi.total_amount) AS monthly_sales
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN retail.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 quarter'
  AND o.order_date < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 quarter'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS last_year_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AS this_year_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS this_q2_start
)
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month_start,
  SUM(oi.total_amount) AS monthly_sales
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN retail.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE (
    o.order_date >= b.last_year_start AND o.order_date < b.this_year_start
  )
  OR (
    o.order_date >= b.this_year_start AND o.order_date < b.this_q2_start
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_date) AS quarter_start, s.store_name, SUM(oi.total_amount) AS sales
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year' + INTERVAL '9 months')
  AND o.order_date < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3 months'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
